label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Held at 331 for a third consecutive UNGRD balance (Aug 25 and Aug 27, 06:30), the longest the toll has stayed flat since the search-and-rescue window closed.

label: Injured
contestNote: President de la Espriella's Aug 30 national address cited an updated national balance of 4,497 injured, up from 4,449 in UNGRD's Aug 27 06:30 balance.

label: Missing
contestNote: President de la Espriella's Aug 30 national address cited 152 missing — matching Medicina Legal's Aug 29 forensic reconciliation and effectively superseding UNGRD's higher Aug 27 balance of 219, the first time the presidency and Medicina Legal have converged on a single figure.
delta: unchanged from Medicina Legal's Aug 29 figure; -67 vs UNGRD's Aug 27 balance

label: Families Affected
contestNote: President de la Espriella's Aug 30 address put the toll at 452,782 people affected across 213,400 families in 497 municipios and 16 departments.

label: Structures Destroyed
contestNote: President de la Espriella's Aug 30 address cited 35,987 homes destroyed and 198,601 damaged, up from UNGRD's Aug 27 balance of 33,395 destroyed / 187,839 damaged, across 497 municipios (from 496).

label: Departments Affected
contestNote: Holding at 16 departments in the Aug 30 presidential balance, but the municipio count widened again to 497 (from 496 on Aug 27); which department was added beyond Decree 1261's original 15 remains unclarified.

label: Reconstruction Cost Estimate
contestNote: Estimates range from Oxford Economics' $1–2B to USGS's ~$40B (7% of GDP) — a 20x spread. Vice President Restrepo separately estimated Caldas department's reconstruction alone could cost up to COP 1.4 trillion.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
contestNote: New shallow aftershocks continue near the epicentral zone — an eight-tremor sequence (six in Chocó, largest M3.9–4.0) overnight into Aug 29, a M3.4 near Istmina before dawn on Aug 30, and a M2.4 near Docordó (Litoral del San Juan, Chocó) at 05:30 on Aug 31 — though SGC has not published an updated running total since 325+ (Aug 17).
